svg.text: Prison Rig · riot with allies · ~4 min
Shock grid, 4 m tiles: row sweep, checkerboard,
closing ring; next pattern flashes 1.5 s early
Control desk on each gantry: take it (hold
interact) — that side's tiles go dead for good
Release panel (hold 2 s) opens a block:
Prisoners follow the nearest player — the path
you take is theirs; live tiles kill them
Guards on the gantries shift fire to the
Stair core opens at two desks; headcount at
Solo: slower cycle, one desk opens the stairs.
No fail — death re-forms at the entry.
